ai.title: AI helps nurses stay one step ahead in chronic disease care, new review finds
ai.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is helping nurses better predict health problems before they become emergencies, according to a new review of existing research published in JMIR Nursing. The study found that AI-based nursing interventions can improve the care of people living with chronic illnesses by identifying patients at greater risk of complications, reducing unplanned hospital visits and potentially lowering health care costs.
ai.title_cn: 新审查发现，人工智能帮助护士在慢性病护理方面领先一步
ai.description_cn: 根据JMIR Nursing上发表的对现有研究的新评论，人工智能（AI）正在帮助护士在健康问题成为紧急情况之前更好地预测它们。研究发现，基于人工智能的护理干预措施可以通过识别并发症风险较高的患者、减少计划外就诊并可能降低医疗保健成本来改善慢性病患者的护理。
